name: epistemic-skills
description: The full epistemic-discipline collection in one package: an entry point plus fifteen disciplines including recon (territory mapping: brief, initiative, and external-candidate modes), resolve (question settling: derivation, literature, and probe instruments), goal authoring, outsource repo-backed external handoff, adversarial review, evidence-locked acceptance, decision persistence with resumption re-anchoring, mission custody (the manifest seat), open-questions clarification, and context-audit instruction hygiene, with usage guidance from epistemic and direct access to every method.

interface.longDescription: An entry point plus fifteen composable disciplines for recon (territory mapping: brief, initiative, and external-candidate modes), resolve (question settling: derivation, literature, and probe instruments), goal authoring, outsource repo-backed external handoff, adversarial review, evidence-locked acceptance, decision persistence with resumption re-anchoring, mission custody (the manifest seat), open-questions clarification, and context-audit instruction hygiene, with usage guidance from epistemic and direct access to every method.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the appropriate epistemic discipline.
Write an evidence-bound completion contract for this goal.
Create a repo-backed outsource handoff and short copy/paste prompt.
Stress-test this high-stakes decision with the gauntlet.
